title: Integración de CI/CD y GitOps para apertura automática de Pull Request
description: Implementación de los workflows de GitHub Actions necesarios para ejecutar pruebas unitarias, análisis estático y despliegue continuo, así como la configuración del motor GitOps que genera automáticamente el primer Pull Request al detectar cambios en la rama de mejora.
author: ATOMUM Bot
commit_message: Add CI workflow, static analysis, and GitOps PR automation

pull_request.title: feat: Add CI/CD pipeline and GitOps PR automation
pull_request.body:
This PR introduces:

- A GitHub Actions workflow (`ci.yml`) that runs unit tests, linting (flake8), type checking (mypy) and code coverage on every push.
- A second workflow (`pull_request.yml`) that triggers the GitOps engine to open a Pull Request when the `feature/ci-gitops-integration` branch is pushed.
- Helper script `gitops-open-pr.sh` used by the GitOps engine to create the PR with the appropriate metadata.
- Minor documentation updates in `README.md` describing the new CI/CD process.
- Minor refactor in `src/main.py` to improve testability.

The GitOps engine will now automatically open the first PR against `main` once this branch is pushed, enabling a fully automated delivery pipeline.
pull_request.head: feature/ci-gitops-integration
